class.name: ParticipantViewport
class.brief_description: Shows several [ParticipantWindow] nodes side by side, one per local player.
class.description: Splits the screen into a grid with one cell per added window, and updates it when windows are added, removed or resized. Mouse and keyboard follow window focus as usual. Joypads are sent to the window chosen with [method assign_device]. [codeblock] var tiler := ParticipantViewport.new() add_child(tiler) for seat in seats: tiler.add_slot(seat.window) tiler.assign_device(seat.device_id, seat.window) [/codeblock] Windows are not reparented or freed by this node.

method.name: add_slot
method.description: Adds [param slot] to the grid, shows it, and returns it. Adding it twice has no effect.

method.name: assign_device
method.description: Sends every joypad event from [param device_id] to [param slot]. [param slot] must be added first. Assigning the device again replaces the previous slot.

method.name: device_slot
method.description: Returns the slot [param device_id] is assigned to, or [code]null[/code].

method.name: get_slots
method.description: Returns the slots in grid order, from the top left, row by row.

method.name: remove_slot
method.description: Removes [param slot] from the grid, hides it, and unassigns its devices. Does not free it.

members.member: Same as [member Viewport.gui_embed_subwindows] on the enclosing viewport. Turn it off to give each player a separate OS window.
